author: Pelpelajax
body: On behalf of the Officials and Referees, I would like to congratulate Berzerk for winning the Omega Championship. It's been a bumpy ride, and we have a lot of areas to improve on. We'll take all your feedback into consideratiom when planning Tournament Number #2. We'll get your prices sorted out soon. Once again, well done to all!
